description_expanded: OverviewGulf FrontGulf-Front, Pet Friendly w/ 2 Private Balconies - Serene Inlet BeachThe SpaceInlet Beach - Walton Mag 3 QUICK HIGHLIGHTS: 2 Bedrooms – Both with full ensuite bathrooms for ultimate comfort Gulf Front – Easy beach access to pristine sands Pet Friendly - Pet fee and deposit required 2 Private Balconies with Gulf Views – Stunning sunsets & ocean breezes Outdoor Dining on Balcony – Enjoy alfresco meals with breathtaking Gulf scenery Fully Equipped Kitchen – Featuring quartz countertops & stainless steel appliances 2 Beach Bike Cruisers Included – Explore 30A’s trails & scenic coastal areas Accommodates 2 Vehicles – Private driveway & carport for easy parking High-Speed Wi-Fi & Cable on All TVs – Stay connected & entertained Professionally Managed – 24/7 guest support for a seamless vacation Step right onto the soft white sands from your private patio at this stunning beachfront townhome in peaceful Inlet Beach. Perfectly located on a private stretch of beach, this getaway offers the ultimate combination of tranquility, comfort, and coastal charm, with breathtaking Gulf views from every level. This spacious two-bedroom, two-and-a-half-bath townhome features 1,275 square feet of beautifully designed living space. The kitchen and bathrooms have been newly renovated, offering a fresh and modern feel throughout. With both covered and open porches, you can enjoy your morning coffee while watching the sunrise or unwind in the evening with spectacular sunset views. From the living room, you can gaze out at the waves, and from the master bedroom, you’ll have your own private oceanfront balcony. The townhome is equipped with Wi-Fi and cable TV, ensuring you stay connected and entertained throughout your stay. It’s also solar-powered, providing a large portion of the home’s energy needs—allowing you to enjoy a sustainable, eco-friendly vacation. You’ll fall in love with our private, peaceful stretch of beach. It’s the ideal spot to relax, take a dip, or just enjoy the view — and since it’s never crowded, you’ll feel like you have it all to yourself. Best of all, the sand is just steps away from your porch! While you’ll feel a world away from it all, you’re still just minutes from a wide variety of restaurants and shops in Inlet Beach, as well as the charming communities of Rosemary Beach, Alys Beach, Seagrove, and Seaside. Whether you’re looking for a romantic getaway, a family retreat, or simply a peaceful escape by the sea, this home has everything you need for a memorable stay on Florida’s beautiful Gulf Coast. ** 30A Vacay rental agreement is required to be signed prior to arrival** ** No Smoking / No Vaping: Smoking or vaping is strictly prohibited on the premises, indoors or outdoors. Violation will result in immediate removal and forfeiture of rental payment. ** Minimum Age: Primary renters must be 25 years or older A Few Notes To Keep In Mind -$150 non refundable Pet Fee and $500 Refundable Pet Deposit Required. Please contact our office after booking to add your pets to your reservation. -Guests will be required to be present at the property for any maintenance issues if you are unable to crate or contain your pet. -Walton County does not allow pets on the beach without a permit. In order to obtain a permit, you must be a Walton County resident. SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (6) Master Bedroom – King sized bed, ensuite bath (walk in shower) Guest Bedroom – Queen sized bed, ensuite bath (shower/tub combo) Common Area – Full sized futon, half bath/powder room SURROUNDING AREA: * Adjacent Camp Helen State Park (boating, kayak rental, fishing, hiking, & wildlife viewing) * Beaches of S. Walton 18-mile paved path (walking, jogging, & biking) * Snorkeling, diving, deep sea & shallow-water fly fishing expeditions * Eden Gardens State Park (Tucker Bayou home & nature trails) * Rosemary Beach (a short walk down the beach) * Seaside (only a few convenient minutes down Hwy. 30-A) * Sidewalk cafes, eclectic boutiques, & chic restaurants * Publix and Winn Dixie supermarkets and CVS pharmacy (1 mile) *Paddleboarding and kayaking at Camp Helen (short walk down the beach) *Yoga and SUP Yoga at Carillion Beach (1 mile) * Shipwreck Island Water Park * New NW FL PC International Airport (ECP) (9 Miles) (Southwest Airlines + private planes) * World-renowned championship golf courses (8 courses within 15 minutes) * Family oriented Pier Park (boardwalk, pier, ferris wheel, shops, sidewalk cafes, Jimmy Buffet's Margaritaville, Music, Bars, Dining, iMax Digital Theater) * The Silver Sands Factory Stores (100+ designer names)Show less
